integrator-guide.title: Integrator guide — authoring a virtual app by hand
integrator-guide.description: This guide walks you through creating a new virtual app in OpenBuild without using the visual editor (which lives in chain spec openbuild-page-editor — not yet shipped). At this stage, OpenBuild is integrator-only: you write JSON and the runtime renders it.

intro.title: OpenBuild
intro.description: Get started with OpenBuild, the no-code app builder inside Nextcloud. Compose apps from OpenRegister schemas, OpenConnector flows, and Pipelinq.

openbuild-rbac.title: OpenBuild RBAC — Per-Virtual-App Permissions
openbuild-rbac.description: OpenBuild's per-virtual-app role-based access control (RBAC) layers on

openbuild-runtime.title: OpenBuild Runtime
openbuild-runtime.description: This document describes how OpenBuild renders a virtual app at runtime — the manifest endpoint, the nested CnAppRoot mount, and the workaround that bridges the gap until the in-memory useAppManifest overload ships in @conduction/nextcloud-vue.

template-store.title: Remote template store
template-store.description: The template store lets you discover and install apps from a remote

tutorials/admin/admin-settings.title: Manage OpenBuild settings
tutorials/admin/admin-settings.description: The three things every OpenBuild admin touches — version info, OpenRegister wiring and the support contact.

tutorials/admin/rbac.title: Manage who can build (RBAC)
tutorials/admin/rbac.description: Decide which Nextcloud groups can open the builder, edit virtual apps, publish, and export.

tutorials/admin/template-catalogue.title: Curate the template catalogue
tutorials/admin/template-catalogue.description: Promote an exported virtual app into the template gallery so other builders can clone from it.

tutorials/create-a-virtual-app.title: Tutorial: Create a virtual app
tutorials/create-a-virtual-app.description: Audience: OpenBuild admins creating their first virtual app on a fresh install or alongside existing apps.

tutorials/update-a-virtual-app.title: Tutorial: Update a virtual app
tutorials/update-a-virtual-app.description: Audience: OpenBuild admins who have already created an app via the wizard and want to evolve it — design schemas, edit pages, switch between versions, and promote changes through the chain.

tutorials/user/connect-data.title: Connect a register or connector
tutorials/user/connect-data.description: Point a page at an existing OpenRegister register, or pull data from an external system via OpenConnector.

tutorials/user/create-from-template.title: Create an application from a template
tutorials/user/create-from-template.description: Clone a template from the gallery to bootstrap a new virtual app with sensible schemas and pages.

tutorials/user/design-page.title: Design a page
tutorials/user/design-page.description: Compose the screens of a virtual app — index lists, detail pages, forms, dashboards — from the page designer.

tutorials/user/design-schema.title: Design a schema
tutorials/user/design-schema.description: Define the data shape behind a virtual app — properties, types, required fields, references — with the schema designer.

tutorials/user/export-app.title: Export your app
tutorials/user/export-app.description: Download a virtual app as a ZIP bundle — manifest + schemas + sample data — that can be imported into another OpenBuild instance.

tutorials/user/first-launch.title: Open OpenBuild for the first time
tutorials/user/first-launch.description: Open OpenBuild, walk the navigation, and confirm the seed Hello World virtual app loaded.

tutorials/user/preview-app.title: Preview and run your app
tutorials/user/preview-app.description: Open the virtual app in its live shell — the same surface end users will see — and click through it like a real user.

tutorials/user/version-snapshots.title: Snapshot and roll back a version
tutorials/user/version-snapshots.description: Save a named snapshot of your virtual app, compare it against the current draft, and roll back if needed.

widgets.title: Widgets
widgets.description: The widget library you can drop onto any OpenBuild page — object widgets (Data, Object relations, tables, charts, KPIs) and content widgets (text, media, navigation), each configurable in-app.
